test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I __graciously__ welcomed my boss at my birthday party.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nicely**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"graciously"** means in a courteous, kind, and pleasant manner. (शालीनता से)

 
 
• **Example: **She graciously accepted the award on behalf of her team.
 
 
 
• **"Nicely" **refers to doing something in a pleasant, kind, or satisfactory manner. (अच्छे तरीके से)
 
 
• **Example: **He nicely explained the process to the new employees.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'graciously' **is **'nicely'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Nicely**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bravely **(बहादुरी से): In a courageous manner.

 
 
• **Example:** She bravely faced the challenges that came her way.
 
 
 
• **Cleverly **(चतुराई से ): In a quick-witted and inventive manner.
 
 
• **Example: **He cleverly solved the puzzle in no time.
 
 
 
• **Courageously** (साहसपूर्वक): In a manner showing courage.
 
 
• **Example:** She courageously defended her ideas during the debate.
